note: The fuzzer-controlled bytes are attached to the synthetic reader and drive all later card data.
The first two input bytes determine the size of the next returned chunk.
The reader hands attacker-shaped chunks to OpenSC APDU handling and card parsing.
Algorithm-attributes blobs from the fuzzed reader are parsed into key_info structures.
The loop copies blob->len-1 bytes into a fixed-size OID buffer without checking that the blob fits, so the safety obligation is blob->len-1 <= sizeof(oid.value).

code: oid.value[j] = blob->data[j+1]; /* ignore first byte of blob (algo ID) */
note: This write overruns the stack OID buffer when the fuzzed blob is long enough, producing the reported stack-buffer-overflow.
